ios.desc:
Search fashion with your camera or your words.
See it. Snap it. Find it.

VISUAL SEARCH
Take a photo of any outfit. We'll find similar pieces across top brands instantly.

VIBE SEARCH
Describe what you're looking for in your own words. "Something cozy for a weekend brunch" works just fine.

PRICE TRACKING
Save items and we track the price for you. Get notified when it actually drops.

COMPLETE THE LOOK
Found a top? We suggest matching pants, shoes, and accessories.

STYLE PROFILE
The app learns what you like. Your feed gets better every time you use it.

- One search, all brands
- Real price drop alerts
- No ads, no fees
- Data stays on your phone

Free to download. Free to use.

quotes.text:
Hey,

I built Bazenda, a product discovery and search engine for US brands.
It helps you quickly browse clothing and accessories from different brands in one place — no selling, no checkout, just fast discovery.

You can:
 •search across brands
 •see trending items
 •check price history
 •find similar items with a quick photo

Bazenda updates itself automatically as brands add or change products.

Would love any feedback on the experience, search results, or the overall concept.

Website: https://bazenda.com
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bazenda/id6742709382
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bazenda.app

Thanks!
